question.text: A reaction at 1 bar is non-spontaneous at low temperature but becomes spontaneous at high temperature. Identify the correct statement about the reaction among the following:

options.text: <math><mo>∆</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math>  is negative while  <math><mo>∆</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math>  is positive
Both  <math><mo>∆</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math>  and  <math><mo>∆</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math>  are negative
<math><mo>∆</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math>  is positive while  <math><mo>∆</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math>  is negative
Both <math><mo>∆</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math> and <math><mo>∆</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math> are positive

solution.text:
∆G = ∆H – T∆S (For Spontaneity) (∆G < 0)
So If  ∆H > 0  and  ∆S > 0 for spontaneity then the process is feasible at high temperature and non-feasible at low temperature.
